title: How to count business days left in the month
task: Working days remaining before month-end — quota pacing, close deadlines.
keywords: business days left in month excel
days to month end google sheets

excel.note: Counts today too (if a weekday). Add a holidays range as NETWORKDAYS' 3rd argument.

explanation: EOMONTH(TODAY(),0) is the last day of the current month, and NETWORKDAYS counts the weekdays from today through that date inclusive — from Friday July 24, 2026 that's the 24th, 27th–31st: 6 working days (the verification pins the dates; use TODAY() live). Divide remaining target by this number for a required daily run-rate. Exclude today by starting from TODAY()+1.
